description: This file defines a PHP class EmployeeWorkExperienceSearchFilterParams in the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the PIM module. The class extends a generic FilterParams class and adds employee-specific search filter parameters, notably the employee number. It also sets default sort fields for search queries related to employee work experience.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for filtering employee work experience search results, including sorting and employee identification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameter object and sets a default sort field ('we.jobTitle').

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.
